name: Matrix Anti-Commutator Obfuscation
description: Replaces the scalar energy equation with a matrix condition. Each particle emits a signature matrix based on its state, and interactions generate interference equal to the anti-commutator of the two matrices. Because the chosen matrices are orthogonal and traceless, their anti-commutator is zero, while their squares are positive scalar matrices. The global sum is the zero matrix if and only if no two interacting particles share the same state. This exactly replicates the bipartiteness condition while hiding the graph-coloring nature behind linear algebra, defeating pattern-matching models.
